correctness.rationale: The full reversible generator decomposes under side exchange; antisymmetric spectrum equals the killed n-cube Dirichlet spectrum, and symmetric interlacing rules out smaller positive eigenvalues. The diagonal resolvent yields the unique root in (0,1+lambda). A strictly positive ground eigenfunction proves strict size descent; inverse binomial moments give the two correction terms. Standard-library rational cofactor checks passed 108 cases, and a separately built full-state eigenvalue check passed 21 cases. Finite tests are not infinite proofs.
